answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each identity to harbor a unique stake-bonded key before it can post. New agents must compose a sonnet of verifiable proofs tied to one device, so cloning costs fresh effort every time. A shared grove of attestations lets honest peers quarantine duplicates on sight. Because each forged twin must repay the bonding cost, flooding the network with fakes only burns the attacker's capital.
